description:
Title: Blizzard Online Character Generator

Blizzard creates a cool online tool for creating characters for their new WoW expansion.
When creating a World of Warcraft character, you can start doing two things: 
While you are setting up your account, you can already come up with good character names.
The setup of your account starts with checking whether you have a battle.net account.
If you do not have one yet, you enter the account information and click the link you receive in the confirmation mail.
As soon as you have a battle.net account, you can check if you have an active WoW subscription.
If not, you can select the payment method.
If you choose credit card, enter your credit card information.
If you choose your bank account, enter your IBAN and BIC numbers.
After that you can log into the game and select realm, race and class of your character.
Until now, you should have come up with some good names.
You enter them one by one until a name is still available.
You get a confirmation, and some selfies of your character, as soon as a expansion is released you get another message.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/blizzard-character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BattleNetConfirmation" name="Battle.net confirmation email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CharacterConfirmation" name="Character confirmation and selfies"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionRelease" name="Expansion release message"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CharacterCreation" name="Create a WoW character" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreateCharacter" name="Start creating a character"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartParallel" name="Set up account and come up with names"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" name="Check whether you have a Battle.net account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasBattleNetAccount" name="Have a Battle.net account?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAccountInformation" name="Enter account information"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveBattleNetEmail" name="Receive confirmation email">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BattleNetConfirmation" messageRef="Message_BattleNetConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click the link in the confirmation email"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeBattleNetAccount" name="Continue with a Battle.net account"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" name="Check whether you have an active WoW subscription"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasWoWSubscription" name="Have an active WoW subscription?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select a payment method"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Choose payment method"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" name="Enter credit card information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBankInformation" name="Enter IBAN and BIC numbers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergePaymentDetails" name="Continue after entering payment details"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeSubscription" name="Continue with an active subscription"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIntoGame" name="Log into the game"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" name="Select the character's realm, race and class"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ThinkOfNames" name="Come up with good character names"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_JoinAccountAndNames" name="Account setup and names ready"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter a character name"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckNameAvailability" name="Check whether the character name is available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Is the character name available?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveCharacterConfirmation" name="Receive character confirmation and selfies">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CharacterConfirmation" messageRef="Message_CharacterConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveExpansionMessage" name="Receive a message when the expansion is released">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExpansionRelease" messageRef="Message_ExpansionRelease"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ExpansionMessageReceived" name="Expansion release message received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Parallel" sourceRef="Start_CreateCharacter" targetRef="Gateway_StartParallel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Parallel_To_Account" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Parallel_To_Names" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_ThinkOfNames"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_To_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_HasBattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists" sourceRef="Gateway_HasBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBattleNetAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasBattleNetAccount = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMissing" sourceRef="Gateway_HasBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasBattleNetAccount = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterAccount_To_Email" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveBattleNetEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_To_ClickLink" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveBattleNetEmail" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClickLink_To_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_To_CheckSubscription" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSubscription_To_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_HasWoWSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionActive" sourceRef="Gateway_HasWoWSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_MergeSubscription">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasActiveWoWSubscription = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionInactive" sourceRef="Gateway_HasWoWSubscription" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasActiveWoWSubscription = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPayment_To_Choice" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_SelectPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentCreditCard" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "credit card"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentBankAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterBankInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "bank account"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_To_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" targetRef="Gateway_MergePaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_To_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBankInformation" targetRef="Gateway_MergePaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_To_SubscriptionMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MergePaymentDetails" targetRef="Gateway_MergeSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionMerge_To_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeSubscription" targetRef="Task_LogIntoGame"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_To_SelectOptions" sourceRef="Task_LogIntoGame" targetRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectOptions_To_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" targetRef="Gateway_JoinAccountAndNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThinkNames_To_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_ThinkOfNames" targetRef="Gateway_JoinAccountAndNames"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_To_EnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_JoinAccountAndNames" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_To_CheckAvailability" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_To_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCharacterConfirmation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">nameAvailable = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameUnavailable" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">nameAvailable = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CharacterConfirmation_To_ExpansionMessage" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveCharacterConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveExpansionMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpansionMessage_To_End" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveExpansionMessage" targetRef="End_ExpansionMessageReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CharacterCreation">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Player" name="Player" processRef="Process_CharacterCreation"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Blizzard" name="Blizzard / Battle.net"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BattleNetConfirmation" name="Battle.net confirmation email" sourceRef="Participant_Blizzard" targetRef="Event_ReceiveBattleNetEmail" messageRef="Message_BattleNetConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CharacterConfirmation" name="Character confirmation and selfies" sourceRef="Participant_Blizzard" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCharacterConfirmation" messageRef="Message_CharacterConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ExpansionRelease" name="Expansion release message" sourceRef="Participant_Blizzard" targetRef="Event_ReceiveExpansionMessage" messageRef="Message_ExpansionRelease"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
